text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab foreign ministers discuss the Middle East peace process that is stalemated due to Israeli refusal to return the occupied Arab lands.
- Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara says Arabs wont accept peace with Israel if it was not just.
- Palestinians clash with Israeli forces on the Land Day anniversary and protests cover the lands occupied by Israel since 1948.
- Foreign ministers decide during meetings of the Arab League to freez normalisation of ties with Israel.

- Syria to consider 40 to 50 percent discounts on flights and hotels during a shopping month which would be held either in July or October-November. Tourists during this month will not need visas and exports would be exempt from taxes.
